actions.action: Merge independent edits using the loaded revision
actions.mechanism: Compare each field’s loaded value, local draft, and latest server value; flag only divergent changes.
actions.implementation: Retain the loaded snapshot. On stale-save rejection, fetch latest values, preserve originals, and combine nonconflicting changes into an unpublished draft.
actions.check: Test a stale tab edited after another tab saved: independent changes survive; divergent same-field changes are flagged, regardless of timestamps.
actions.risk: Missing snapshot data must block automatic merging, not guess.

actions.action: Replace the warning with field-level resolution
actions.mechanism: Show only conflicting fields, with labeled local and saved versions and explicit resolution controls.
actions.implementation: For long text, provide inline differences and an editable combined result. For single-choice fields, require selection. Retain originals; save only as draft.
actions.check: Resolve text and choice conflicts entirely in one tab without dragging, window-to-window copying, retyping independent edits, or publishing.
actions.risk: Long differences need accessible navigation and expandable full originals.

actions.mechanism: A per-tab recovery journal retains both text versions even after users select a replacement.
actions.implementation: Store local drafts and fetched conflict versions in IndexedDB before replacing editor state. Offer in-editor restoration; require explicit deletion of recovery entries.
actions.check: Reload during resolution and after choosing one version; verify both original texts remain recoverable without using another window.
actions.risk: Storage failure must block destructive replacement; sensitive drafts need safeguards.

actions.action: Notify other tabs without replacing their drafts
actions.mechanism: An advisory cross-tab message reveals newer revisions before saving; server revision checks remain authoritative.
actions.implementation: After draft saves, broadcast document ID and revision. Show a nonblocking review banner in sibling tabs; fetch latest values only for reconciliation.
actions.check: Edit the stale tab after receiving the banner; reconciliation must retain that edit. Drop messages and confirm stale-save rejection still works.
actions.risk: Notifications can arrive late; never treat them as locks.
